translations.translatedText: # Friday 29.4.2022 (radio)
Municipal sector strike. New nuclear reactor. Price rises. Ministers. May Day and the May Day weather.
## Municipal sector strike

![Classroom. Desks in tidy rows, a large screen on the wall.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4028,h_2265,x_3,y_232/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-89829861d2ed143b268/1641214749)
Open image viewer
Many schools are closed during the strike. Photo: Mikko Savolainen / Yle
Municipal sector employees are going on strike.
The strike begins in 10 cities on Tuesday. Then about 80,000 employees will stop work. They will be away from work for a week.
The strike is, for example, in the Helsinki region, Tampere, Turku and Oulu.
During the strike many schools and day-care centres are closed. The strike also affects, for example, the operation of libraries.
The reason for the strike is money. The employer and employees are in dispute about pay.
## Electricity from a nuclear reactor in autumn

![Olkiluoto 3 nuclear power plant in Eurajoki on 22.11.2021.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4237,h_2384,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-884214619fa81945f58/1639724662)
Open image viewer
Olkiluoto's 3rd nuclear reactor. Photo: Kimmo Hiltunen / Yle
Olkiluoto's new nuclear reactor will not start producing electricity regularly until September. Earlier it was reported that the new nuclear reactor would start producing electricity in the summer.
The nuclear reactor's systems still have to be checked and repaired. In addition, more tests will be carried out.
When the new nuclear reactor is put into use, it will produce about 15 percent of Finland's electricity.
The new nuclear reactor is Olkiluoto's third (3rd) nuclear reactor. It was completed more than 10 years late.
## Price rises

![A digital display showing the price of petrol and diesel at a petrol station.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4989,h_2800,x_0,y_104/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-927722622f1fdbc50ea/1647256195)
Open image viewer
The price of petrol has risen a lot. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Inflation in the euro area is high, that is, prices are now rising fast. Inflation is already 7.5 percent.
The price of energy has risen the most. The reason for this is Russia's war in Ukraine. Because of the war, the price of energy has risen in the euro area by 38 percent on average.
The euro area includes 19 European countries whose currency is the euro.
## New ministers
![Antti Kurvinen and Petri Honkonen on 31 March.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5000,h_2812,x_0,y_521/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-9366386246c63e15bed/1648805574)
Open image viewer
Antti Kurvinen and Petri Honkonen. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
2 ministers have changed in the government. President Sauli Niinistö appointed the new ministers on Friday.
Antti Kurvinen is the new Minister of Agriculture and Forestry. Kurvinen was previously Minister of Science and Culture. The new Minister of Science and Culture is Petri Honkonen.
The party of Kurvinen and Honkonen is the Centre.
## May Day
![Two girls sit on a jetty in student overalls.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3024,h_1701,x_0,y_89/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-947532626a6425ec54e/1651139724)
Open image viewer
May Day is a festival of students. Photo: Nerg Jenni / Yle
May Day is celebrated at the weekend.
On Saturday it is May Eve and on Sunday May Day.
In Finland, May Day is celebrated especially by students.
## The weather
![Weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12424217)
Open image viewer
The weather is chilly, that is, cold for the time of year. On Saturday, May Eve, the temperature in the south is about 8 degrees. In Northern Lapland there is a little frost.
In the central parts of the country sleet or snow showers will fall on Saturday. However, in most of the country it is dry, that is, without rain.
On Sunday, May Day, the weather warms slightly. In the south the temperature rises to a little over 10 degrees. Even in Lapland the temperature is a little above zero.
